query:
SELECT string_agg(
                      '''' || replace(replace(w, '\', '\\'), '''', '''''') || ''''
                      || CASE WHEN char_length(w) >= 3 THEN ':*' ELSE '' END,
                      ' & ' ORDER BY w) AS "query"
           FROM unnest(tsvector_to_array(to_tsvector('simple', $1))) w
